chapter: Reel two to four: pay, tailgate and style
title: Tom Zimmerman, Isle of Capri and other venues Pecora never played
summary: Allen asks about Tom Zimmerman, Isle of Capri and the Jung Roof; Pecora did not know or play them.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: They tell me it's a laundry or something now. I don't know what that is. Did you ever know Tom Zimmerman? You mean Roy? No, no, he was a piano player, but he was no kin to Roy. No. He used to work with Johnny Deidroy. I just wondered if you ever know him. Probably, you know, at another time. No, I don't think so. You said Frank Cuny was with him. Did you ever go to the Isle of Capri in Biloxi? I was going to ask you about that. Winger used to talk about that.
Yeah, you just played the White House over there. And the Jung Roof, did you ever play the Jung Roof?
